---
title: "DENV pseudotime: inferred time of arrest"
format: html
---



```{r packages}
remotes::install_github("MaomLab/MPStats")
library(MPStats)
```

```{r analysis-parameters}
date_code <- "20260813"

TIME_GRID   <- seq(from = 0, to = 48, by = 0.1)  ## CHANGED: 481 pts, was 50
T_SCALE     <- 6      # Student-t scale, hours
T_DF        <- 2      # Student-t degrees of freedom (heavy tails = robust)
T_MIN       <- 0
T_MAX       <- 48
POOL_WEIGHT <- "normalized"  # "normalized" (w = 1/n_models) or "independent"
```

## Helper functions

```{r helpers}
## dt((x - mu)/s, df) is the density of the *standardised* variable;
## the density of x needs the 1/s Jacobian.
## With a single shared scale this is a constant offset for pairwise models,
## but for one-vs-all models the offset is s-dependent and does NOT cancel.
dt_scaled <- function(x, mu, scale, df, log = FALSE) {
  ld <- stats::dt((x - mu) / scale, df = df, log = TRUE) - log(scale)
  if (log) ld else exp(ld)
}

# numerically stable log(exp(la) + exp(lb))
log_add <- function(la, lb) {
  m <- pmax(la, lb)
  out <- m + log(exp(la - m) + exp(lb - m))
  out[is.infinite(m) & m < 0] <- -Inf
  out
}

#' Log-likelihood of arrest time `x` from one pairwise model.
#'
#' MIXTURE, not geometric mean:  l(x|s) = (1-s) f(x; t0) + s f(x; t1)
#' This is a proper density for every s, and its mode sits at t0 or t1.
loglik_pairwise <- function(x, t0, t1, s, scale = T_SCALE, df = T_DF) {
  s <- pmin(pmax(s, 0), 1)
  log_add(
    log(1 - s) + dt_scaled(x, t0, scale, df, log = TRUE),
    log(s)     + dt_scaled(x, t1, scale, df, log = TRUE))
}

#' Log-likelihood of arrest time `x` from one one-vs-all model.
#'
#' MIXTURE of the anchored t and a uniform "no information" component:
#'   l(x|s) = s f(x; t1) + (1-s) / (T_MAX - T_MIN)
loglik_one_vs_all <- function(x, t1, s, scale = T_SCALE, df = T_DF,
                              t_min = T_MIN, t_max = T_MAX) {
  s <- pmin(pmax(s, 0), 1)
  log_add(
    log(s)     + dt_scaled(x, t1, scale, df, log = TRUE),
    log(1 - s) - log(t_max - t_min))
}

#' Normalize a log-density over a uniform grid; returns density on that grid.
normalize_log_density <- function(log_l, t) {
  log_l <- log_l - max(log_l, na.rm = TRUE)
  d <- exp(log_l)
  d / (sum(d) * (t[2] - t[1]))
}

#' MAP, posterior mean and equal-tailed credible interval from a grid density.
summarize_posterior <- function(t, density, level = 0.95) {
  dt_ <- t[2] - t[1]
  p   <- density * dt_
  p   <- p / sum(p)
  cdf <- cumsum(p)
  a   <- (1 - level) / 2
  tibble::tibble(
    map      = t[which.max(density)],
    mean     = sum(t * p),
    sd       = sqrt(sum((t - sum(t * p))^2 * p)),
    lower    = t[which.min(abs(cdf - a))],
    upper    = t[which.min(abs(cdf - (1 - a)))],
    # peak-to-trough contrast, for the "flat landscape" claim about pralatrexate
    contrast = max(density) - min(density))
}
```

## Load the concentration-response scores

```{r load-data}
dr_plate_map <- readr::read_csv(
  file = here::here("src/dr_plate_map_mjo_20230724.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)

DR_scored <- data.frame(
  filename = list.files(
    path = here::here("Jill_analysis/"),
    pattern = "DR_scored_[^_]+_[^.]+\\.csv",
    full.names = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  dplyr::do({
    filename <- .$filename[1]
    cat("Reading ", filename, "\n", sep = "")
    readr::read_csv(file = filename, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        condition_1 = filename |>
          stringr::str_extract("DR_scored_([^_]+)_([^.]+)\\.csv$", group = 1),
        condition_2 = filename |>
          stringr::str_extract("DR_scored_([^_]+)_([^.]+)\\.csv$", group = 2) |>
          stringr::str_replace("vs_", ""),
        .before = 1)
  }) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    row    = MPStats::well_id_to_row(Image_Metadata_WellID),
    column = MPStats::well_id_to_column(Image_Metadata_WellID),
    .before = 7) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    dr_plate_map,
    by = c("Image_Metadata_PlateID" = "PlateID", "row", "column")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    treatment = dplyr::case_when(
      treatment == "Nexium" ~ "Esomeprazole",
      TRUE ~ treatment))

DR_scored |>
  readr::write_tsv(here::here(paste0("product/DR_scored_", date_code, ".tsv")))
```

```{r audit-scores}
## XGBRegressor with squared-error loss is UNBOUNDED. check how many fall out side of [0-1]
score_audit <- DR_scored |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    n          = dplyr::n(),
    min        = min(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max        = max(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_below_0  = sum(score < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_above_1  = sum(score > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_missing  = sum(is.na(score)))
print(score_audit)

if (score_audit$n_below_0 > 0 || score_audit$n_above_1 > 0) {
  warning(
    "Out-of-range XGBoost scores: ",
    score_audit$n_below_0, " below 0, ", score_audit$n_above_1, " above 1. ",
    "Clipping to [0, 1]. Consider retraining with binary:logistic, or ",
    "calibrating scores (Platt / isotonic) on held-out folds.")
}

## Record how many models each well is scored under -- if any
## well is missing a model the pooled likelihoods are not comparable.
DR_scored |>
  dplyr::count(Image_Metadata_PlateID, Image_Metadata_WellID,
               name = "n_model_scores") |>
  dplyr::count(n_model_scores) |>
  print()
```

```{r parse-model-anchors}
## Parse condition_1 / condition_2 into anchor times ONCE, explicitly,
## and assert the polarity assumption instead of leaving it implicit.
##
## Convention assumed here (matches the filenames and Supplementary Figure 3):
##   condition_1 = the class labelled 0, condition_2 = the class labelled 1
##   pairwise:    "0_vs_12"   -> t0 = 0,  t1 = 12,  score -> 1 means "late"
##   one-vs-all:  "all_vs_12" -> t0 = NA, t1 = 12,  score -> 1 means "like 12h"
model_scores <- DR_scored |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    model_type = dplyr::if_else(condition_1 == "all", "one_vs_all", "pairwise"),
    t0 = dplyr::if_else(condition_1 == "all", NA_real_,
                        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(condition_1))),
    t1 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(condition_2)),
    score = pmin(pmax(score, 0), 1),                  ## CHANGED: clip
    model_id = paste0(condition_1, "_vs_", condition_2))

stopifnot(
  "unparsed anchor time points" =
    !any(is.na(model_scores$t1)),
  "pairwise models must have t0 < t1 for the 0/1 label convention to hold" =
    all(model_scores$t0 < model_scores$t1, na.rm = TRUE))

n_models <- dplyr::n_distinct(model_scores$model_id)
message("n models = ", n_models)   # expect 21
```

## Per-well likelihood of the time of arrest

```{r estimate-time-of-arrest}
## Here: (1) pool models within a well by summing weighted log-likelihoods,
##       (2) then summarise across replicate wells.
pool_w <- switch(
  POOL_WEIGHT,
  normalized  = 1 / n_models,  # log-linear opinion pool; weights sum to 1
  independent = 1)             # naive independence (Methods as written)

well_loglik <- model_scores |>
  dplyr::select(Image_Metadata_PlateID, Image_Metadata_WellID,
                condition, treatment, dose_uM,
                model_id, model_type, t0, t1, score) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(t = TIME_GRID) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ll = dplyr::if_else(
      model_type == "pairwise",
      loglik_pairwise(t, t0, t1, score),
      loglik_one_vs_all(t, t1, score))) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    Image_Metadata_PlateID, Image_Metadata_WellID,
    condition, treatment, dose_uM, t) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    ll = sum(pool_w * ll),
    n_models_used = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop")

stopifnot(all(well_loglik$n_models_used == n_models))

## Normalise per well, then average the DENSITIES across replicate wells.
well_density <- well_loglik |>
  dplyr::group_by(Image_Metadata_PlateID, Image_Metadata_WellID,
                  condition, treatment, dose_uM) |>
  dplyr::mutate(density = normalize_log_density(ll, t)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

condition_density <- well_density |>
  dplyr::group_by(condition, treatment, dose_uM, t) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    density    = mean(density),
    density_se = sd(density) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),   ## CHANGED: replicate error
    n_wells    = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop")
```

```{r plot-time-of-arrest}
plot_data_4 <- condition_density |>
  dplyr::filter(
    treatment %in% c("GW4064", "Esomeprazole", "Pralatrexate", "LY411575")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    treatment = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("GW4064", "Esomeprazole", "Pralatrexate", "LY411575")))

plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = plot_data_4) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(
      x = t,
      ymin = density - density_se,
      ymax = density + density_se,
      group = dose_uM,
      fill = log10(dose_uM)),
    alpha = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(
      x = t, y = density, group = dose_uM, color = log10(dose_uM)),
    linewidth = 1.3) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(facets = dplyr::vars(treatment), nrow = 1) +
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(
    begin = 0.1, end = 0.9,
    breaks = c(-3, 0), labels = c("1 nM", "1 uM"), option = "plasma") +
  viridis::scale_fill_viridis(begin = 0.1, end = 0.9, option = "plasma") +
  ggplot2::ggtitle("Inferred time of arrest") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Inferred time of arrest (h)",
    ## CHANGED: this is a probability density, not a "likelihood score" and
    ## certainly not a percentage.
    y = expression("Posterior density ("*h^-1*")"),
    color = "Dose")
plot

for (ext in c("pdf", "png")) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = here::here(paste0(
      "product/inferred_time_of_arrest_", date_code, ".", ext)),
    plot = plot, width = 7.3, height = 3)
}

condition_density |>
  readr::write_tsv(here::here(paste0(
    "product/inferred_time_of_arrest_", date_code, ".tsv")))
```

## Point estimates with uncertainty

```{r define-endpoint}
arrest_estimates <- well_density |>
  dplyr::group_by(Image_Metadata_PlateID, Image_Metadata_WellID,
                  condition, treatment, dose_uM) |>
  dplyr::reframe(summarize_posterior(t, density)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(condition, treatment, dose_uM) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    n_wells       = dplyr::n(),
    map_median    = median(map),
    mean_mean     = mean(mean),
    mean_se       = sd(mean) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    lower_median  = median(lower),
    upper_median  = median(upper),
    contrast_mean = mean(contrast),
    ## flag boundary solutions. A MAP pinned at 0 or 48 means the
    ## likelihood is monotone across the whole window -- i.e. "at or beyond
    ## this edge", NOT "arrest at 0.0 h" or "arrest at 48.0 h".
    frac_at_lower = mean(map <= T_MIN + 0.5),
    frac_at_upper = mean(map >= T_MAX - 0.5),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    boundary_flag = dplyr::case_when(
      frac_at_lower > 0.5 ~ "monotone toward t = 0 (unresolved, <= 0 h)",
      frac_at_upper > 0.5 ~ "monotone toward t = 48 (unresolved, >= 48 h)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_))

print(arrest_estimates, n = 50)

arrest_estimates |>
  readr::write_tsv(here::here(paste0(
    "product/arrest_estimates_", date_code, ".tsv")))
```

```{r plot-endpoint}
plot1 <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = arrest_estimates) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 48, linewidth = 1.1, color = "darkgray") +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(
      x = log10(dose_uM),
      ymin = mean_mean - mean_se, ymax = mean_mean + mean_se,
      group = treatment, fill = treatment),
    alpha = 0.15, show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(
      x = log10(dose_uM), y = mean_mean,
      group = treatment, color = treatment),
    linewidth = 1.5) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_discrete(
    "", guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 3)) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    "Dose", breaks = -3:1,
    labels = c("1nM", "10nM", "100nM", "1uM", "10uM")) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    "Inferred time of arrest (h)", breaks = c(0, 12, 24, 36, 48)) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 51)) +   ## CHANGED: zoom, don't drop
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
plot1

ggplot2::ggsave(
  plot = plot1,
  filename = here::here(paste0("product/arrest_estimates_", date_code, ".pdf")),
  width = 5, height = 4)
```

## Diagnostic: why mixture rather than weighted geometric mean

```{r diagnostic-pooling}
## Explore the difference between geometric and mixture pooling
tg <- seq(0, 48, by = 0.05)
diag_data <- tidyr::expand_grid(s = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), t = tg) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    geometric = exp(
      (1 - s) * dt_scaled(t, 12, T_SCALE, T_DF, log = TRUE) +
      s       * dt_scaled(t, 36, T_SCALE, T_DF, log = TRUE)),
    mixture = exp(loglik_pairwise(t, 12, 36, s))) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(geometric, mixture),
    names_to = "pooling", values_to = "density")

diag_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(pooling, s) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_mass = sum(density) * 0.05,
    mode_at    = t[which.max(density)],
    .groups = "drop") |>
  print(n = 20)

ggplot2::ggplot(data = diag_data) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = c(12, 36), color = "darkgray") +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = t, y = density, color = factor(s)),
    linewidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(facets = dplyr::vars(pooling), scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "t (h)", y = "density", color = "score s")
```
